summary: J.W. Mays, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a secured loan agreement with Beacon Bank Trust. The company borrowed up to $8 million via a non-revolving line of credit, secured by a first mortgage on its Fishkill, NY property. Terms include floating interest rates (WSJ Prime + 100 bps minimum 7.25% during advance period, then 5-year FHLB Boston index + 225 bps minimum 6.00%), 25-year amortization, maturity in May 2036, and maintenance of $1M in deposit accounts. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
